title: A d20 check roll came up as exactly 4 three times in a row (steward's shade will checks, strongbox might check) and later 5 twice in a row (Hundred Gallery will checks) in quick succession, before finally varying — felt suspiciously non-random for a short streak, though not provably broken.
where: Barrow — King's Strongroom / Iron Downs — Hundred Gallery Fall
